How it works

From first message to finished job.

  1. Send us the details

    Fill in the form or call us. Photos and rough sizes help.

  2. We visit and quote

    We measure up and send a written, itemised quote within three days.

  3. We build and fit

    We agree a start date, make everything in our workshop and fit it on site.
